theme: Light theme default with rich terracotta, deep emerald, and warm ochre accents celebrating Mithila culture and rural vibrancy

brand_primary.name: Terracotta Clay
brand_primary.usage: Primary buttons, active indicators, hero highlight accents

brand_secondary.name: Mithila Forest Emerald
brand_secondary.usage: Header accents, section subheadings, badges, primary typography accents

brand_accent.name: Mustard Ochre Gold
brand_accent.usage: Icons, subtle highlight borders, festival badges

spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_mode: MODE A: TETRIS GRID (12 columns on desktop: col-span-full, col-span-8, col-span-4)

visual_enhancers.heritage_motifs: Subtle traditional Mithila geometric border frames (1px terracotta stroke), soft warm shadows (shadow-[0_10px_30px_rgba(27,77,62,0.06)])
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Navigation bar with backdrop-blur-md bg-[#F9F6F0]/85 border-b border-emerald-950/10 z-50 sticky top-0
visual_enhancers.grain_overlay: Optional background CSS radial subtle warm texture or noise filter to remove flat digital sterility

navigation_and_header.structure: Sticky header with blur, brand logo ('Lagma Village | लगमा गाँव'), 5 main navigation links (About, Heritage & Culture, Landmarks, Community & News, Governance & Contact), and a 'Explore Village Map' CTA button

page_sections_architecture.name: Hero - Spirit of Lagma
page_sections_architecture.description: Large editorial hero section featuring a panoramic imagery layer, warm terracotta badge ('Heart of Mithila Culture'), emotional headline ('Lagma Village: Where Ancient Heritage Meets Vibrant Living'), description, and dual CTAs ('Explore Landmarks', 'Village Directory')

page_sections_architecture.name: Key Village Highlights
page_sections_architecture.description: High-density stat counter banner showing village metrics (e.g. '500+ Years Heritage', '12+ Sacred Ponds & Temples', '98% Literacy Drive', '10,000+ Resident & Diaspora Community')

page_sections_architecture.name: Essence & Story of Lagma
page_sections_architecture.description: Asymmetrical two-column editorial spread showcasing the rich history, agricultural roots, ponds (Pokhar), and peaceful community life in Bihar

page_sections_architecture.name: Landmarks & Sacred Pokhars Bento Grid
page_sections_architecture.description: Bento grid displaying key places: Central Village Pond, Historical Temple, Community Chopal, Primary School & Library, Organic Agricultural Fields

page_sections_architecture.name: Mithila Heritage & Traditions Showcase
page_sections_architecture.description: Interactive gallery and tabbed showcase for local art forms, seasonal festivals (Chhath Puja, Durga Puja, Sama Chakeva), and folk music traditions

page_sections_architecture.name: Village Updates & Community Feed
page_sections_architecture.description: Recent announcements, development news, village panchayat initiatives, and cultural gatherings

page_sections_architecture.name: Village Directory & Civic Contact
page_sections_architecture.description: Interactive search or tabbed directory for Emergency Services, Panchayat Representatives, Post Office, and Youth Committee contacts

page_sections_architecture.name: Village Portal Footer
page_sections_architecture.description: Deep forest green dark footer with big typography 'LAGMA', quick navigation links, emergency contact numbers, and cultural quote

motion_guidelines.smooth_scrolling: Use lenis or native smooth scrolling behavior
motion_guidelines.entrance_animations: Framer motion initial {{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate {{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} transition {{ duration: 0.5, ease: 'easeOut' }}
motion_guidelines.stagger_children: Stagger children elements by 0.1s for list items and bento grid cards
motion_guidelines.hover_effects: Cards hover: -translate-y-1 shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 border-[#C85A32]/30

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Never use generic raw dark AI slop gradients or default Vercel dark mode aesthetics for community heritage sites.
Prioritize legibility, contrast (APCA AA compliant text), and human warmth.
All interactive elements (buttons, links, search inputs, tabs, cards) MUST include kebab-case `data-testid` attributes.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or popups - always use solid or glassmorphism with backdrop blur.
Ensure responsive layout for mobile (grid-cols-1) up to desktop (grid-cols-12 / grid-cols-4).
Provide clear JavaScript (.js / .jsx) component guidance, using Shadcn primitives customized with Tailwind CSS classes.
